title: Interview: strengths and weaknesses
description: Answer strengths and weakness questions in an interview, backing every claim with a specific example.

userInputs.label: What role is the interview for?

brief.scene: You are partway through an interview for {{role}}. The interviewer moves on to your strengths.
brief.yourGoal: Back each claim with a specific example, including one real weakness and what you did about it.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: Ask the candidate for {{role}} about their main strengths and ask them to give evidence. One or two sentences only. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.generate: Ask for a real weakness and what the candidate has done about it. One or two sentences only. Reply with one spoken line under 40 words. No stage directions, no markdown, no preamble.

judged.label: Claims backed by examples
judged.criterion: Every claim the speaker makes about a strength or weakness is backed by a specific instance, such as a named project, situation or result. The weakness is real, not a disguised strength, and includes an action taken.

criteriaDisplay: Keep filler words under 4 per minute
Speak between 120 and 170 words per minute
Finish between 1 minute and 2 min 50 sec
Back every claim with a specific example
